lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Clusters of high-luminance pixels forming roughly circular nodes; arranged in multiple horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, with inter-node spacing approximately 2-4 times the node diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows at the locations of the circular nodes, forming a grid-like lattice structure across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp luminance shift from high intensity (top) to shadow (bottom).

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense arrangement of small high-luminance spots, with higher density and smaller spot diameter compared to the flank patterning.
